description: Exactness gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6.5 tests of problems/godunov_norm_1d_periodic_exact.esm (model GodunovNormExact, test constant_field_annihilated_exact) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The first-order Godunov gradient magnitude annihilates a constant field to the bit (|grad(const)| = 0), so the constant state is preserved exactly under u_t = -S*godunov(u): the assertions pin L2_error(u, 3) = 0 at t=0 and t=1 within 1e-13 and mean(u) = 3. This is the cartesian_uniform_1d analogue of the gradient_mpas grad(const) = 0 exactness gate; it drives the compound sqrt((D(u,x))^2) through lowering to a makearray Godunov norm and confirms the whole max/min/sqrt stencil evaluates and integrates. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners. The nontrivial order-1 accuracy of the same rule on smooth data is gated separately by tests/conformance/convergence/godunov_norm_1d_eikonal_mms.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
